position.zh: 当地分公司负责人：常驻经营、组织专业服务、开发项目并推进回款。
position.en: Resident branch lead: run local operations, coordinate specialists, develop projects and manage collections.

promise.zh: 在当地注册公司、聘人、缴税、提供服务，把关系做成能签约和交付的业务。
promise.en: Register locally, employ people, meet tax duties and provide services, turning relationships into contracted, deliverable business.

path.zh: 聘用当地团队并签专业服务
通过现有关系安排正式交流
path.en: Use existing relationships for formal dialogue

path.zh: 选定业务问题并形成方案
path.en: Define a business problem and proposal

path.zh: 本地主体签约、交付、收款和申报
path.en: Contract, deliver, collect and file locally

capabilities.zh: 履历包含库迪阿联酋经营职责，能处理现场事项、供应商和总部之间的日常协同。
capabilities.en: The CV includes UAE operating responsibility at Cotti, linking on-site issues, suppliers and headquarters.

capabilities.zh: 可直接对接Emaar、Al-Futtaim、Saif Belhasa、DMCC；高层关系通过既有介绍链安排。
capabilities.en: Direct access to Emaar, Al-Futtaim, Saif Belhasa and DMCC; use established introduction chains for senior dialogue.

capabilities.zh: 有PRO、律所及财务支持的项目接触经验；明确分工、费用、交付和续期。
capabilities.en: Project experience with PRO, legal and financial support; define scope, fees, outputs and renewals.

capabilities.zh: 以周报、费用、供应商对账和税务配合管理日常经营；总部保留财务审批。
capabilities.en: Use operating reviews, expense control, supplier reconciliation and tax coordination; HQ retains financial approvals.

capabilities.zh: 有当地门店及跨职能协同经历，能够组织招聘、培训、排班和执行跟进。
capabilities.en: Local-store and cross-functional experience supports recruitment, training, scheduling and follow-through.

capabilities.zh: 能组织开发商和合作方对话，把商务诉求交给律师形成可执行的合同。
capabilities.en: Organize developer / partner dialogue and turn commercial requirements into enforceable contracts with counsel.

capabilities.zh: 把技术功能讲成客户业务问题、演示和报价；产品架构与技术承诺由总部专业团队负责。
capabilities.en: Translate features into client problems, demos and prices; HQ specialists own architecture and technical commitments.

capabilities.zh: 组织中英商务材料和跨文化沟通；阿语法律文件、政府提交由本地专业人员处理。
capabilities.en: Prepare Chinese / English business materials and cross-cultural dialogue; local specialists handle Arabic legal and government filings.

legal_form.zh: 经营上采用分公司制，法律上优先评估外国公司分支机构（Branch）。若许可活动或责任安排更适合全资LLC，则采用当地全资子公司，常驻、用工、财税及交付要求不变。不是只设联络地址。
legal_form.en: Use a local branch operating model. First assess a foreign-company Branch; use a wholly owned local LLC if the licensed activity or liability structure fits better. Resident staffing, tax, payroll and delivery stay local; this is more than a mailing address.

setup_steps.zh: 先卖企业软件、接口和数据记录服务；律所逐项判断是否涉及金融或信任服务许可。
setup_steps.en: Start with enterprise software, interfaces and data-record services; counsel maps any financial or trust-service licensing.

setup_steps.zh: 公司登记、章程、董事会决议、负责人授权及身份资料；按主管机关要求做认证和阿语翻译。
setup_steps.en: Parent registration, articles, board resolution, manager authority and identification; attest and translate as required.

setup_steps.zh: 与许可机关确认活动和主体，落实实际办公地址、租约及所需分支登记。
setup_steps.en: Confirm activities / entity with the licensor, secure an office / lease and complete applicable branch registrations.

setup_steps.zh: 开对公银行与财税档案
向银行提交股权、实益拥有人、资金来源与业务说明；建立企业税、VAT适用判断和月结流程。
setup_steps.en: Provide ownership, beneficial owners, funds source and business plan; establish corporate tax, VAT assessment and monthly accounts.

setup_steps.zh: 办理工作许可、居留、保险和劳动合同，按适用体系发薪；政府账号与授权归公司管理。
setup_steps.en: Arrange work permits, residence, insurance and contracts; pay through the applicable system and control company accounts / mandates.

setup_steps.zh: 用本地主体办理供应商准入，准备合同、税务资料、信息安全和数据权限说明。
setup_steps.en: Use the local entity for supplier onboarding, with contracts, tax records, security and data-permission documentation.

jobs.zh: 负责人；当地运营/政府事务协调（M3起）；解决方案工程师（M7起）。除负责人外，新增2个属地招聘岗位。
jobs.en: Branch lead; local operations / government-service coordinator from M3; solutions engineer from M7. Two local hires beyond the lead.

jobs.zh: 增加本地商务人员；总部售前与交付按项目配合，不替代当地团队。
jobs.en: Add local business development; HQ presales / delivery supports projects without replacing the local team.

jobs.zh: 增加初级分析或客户支持；按季度做产品及流程培训，建立本地交接能力。
jobs.en: Add junior analysis / client support; provide quarterly product / process training and build local handover capability.

social_value.zh: 当地招聘、工资与保险、纳税申报、专业服务采购和技术培训都有记录。属地雇佣不等于全部聘用本国公民；Emiratisation等法定义务按人数、活动及主管机关要求单独判断。
social_value.en: Record local hiring, payroll / insurance, tax filing, local professional procurement and technical training. Local residence-based employment is distinct from citizen hiring; assess Emiratisation duties by size, activity and applicable rules.

professional_team.zh: 主体及活动范围、母公司授权、合同、数据、用工和争议；有金融活动时牵头识别许可路径。
professional_team.en: Entity / activities, authority, contracts, data, employment and disputes; identify regulated-activity approvals when relevant.

professional_team.zh: 建账、月结、税务登记及申报、工资与费用；需审计或税务代理时核实对应资格。
professional_team.en: Books, month-end, tax registration / returns, payroll and expenses; check qualifications for statutory audit or tax representation.

professional_team.zh: 熟悉政府办事渠道，长期跟进牌照、移民、劳动和证件事项；配专属客户经理与可查办件台账。
professional_team.en: Experienced government-service coordination for licences, immigration, labour and documents, with a dedicated manager and traceable case log.

pro_case.zh: 库迪资料中有BAK NOVA Government Transaction Centre LLC的双签章PRO协议，以及2026年7月服务发票。协议列有Amer、Tasheel、MoHRE、DET等事务。可作为BUBIX首轮访谈与询价参照，正式范围另签。
pro_case.en: Cotti records include a PRO agreement bearing both parties’ signatures / stamps with BAK NOVA Government Transaction Centre LLC and a July 2026 service invoice. Scope lists Amer, Tasheel, MoHRE and DET work. Use it as an initial interview / quotation reference; agree BUBIX scope separately.

pro_terms.zh: 长期服务协议：专属负责人、服务清单和续期日期。
pro_terms.en: Retainer: dedicated owner, service list and renewal date.

pro_terms.zh: 官方费用、服务费和商务引荐费用分列；逐项有凭证。
pro_terms.en: Separate official charges, service fees and commercial introduction fees, each documented.

pro_terms.zh: 每周更新待办、已提交事项、补件及下一步时间。
pro_terms.en: Weekly log of open cases, submissions, requested documents and next dates.

pro_terms.zh: 公司账号、文件及授权范围归BUBIX控制；退出时完整移交。
pro_terms.en: BUBIX controls accounts, documents and mandate scope; require full exit handover.

pro_terms.zh: 政府办理与商业引荐分别约定；审批和采购由主管部门及买方决定。
pro_terms.en: Contract government processing and business introductions separately; authorities and buyers decide approvals / procurement.

royal_steps.zh: 先通过原有介绍人约见
确认私人办公室或对口机构、称谓、名单和议题，不群发邀约。
royal_steps.en: Agree the office / institution, titles, participants and theme; avoid mass invitations.

royal_steps.zh: 会前发一页公司与议题
royal_steps.en: Send a one-page company / theme brief

royal_steps.zh: 讲清BUBIX在当地设公司、招人、培训和长期服务的安排，再讲一个具体产业问题。
royal_steps.en: Explain local incorporation, jobs, training and long-term service, then one specific industry problem.

royal_steps.zh: 第一次以听取需求为主
用简短演示说明产品；询问哪些企业或项目有类似问题，请对方指定业务联系人。
royal_steps.en: Use a short demo, ask which companies / projects share the problem and request a named business contact.

royal_steps.zh: 由业务团队一起做方案
约运营、技术、采购参加工作会，明确现有系统、数据、预算口径及试点范围。
royal_steps.en: Meet operations, technology and procurement to map systems, data, budget basis and pilot scope.

royal_steps.zh: 交给实际经营主体采购
royal_steps.en: Move to the actual operator’s procurement

royal_steps.zh: 分清谁支持、谁使用、谁签字、谁付款；意向、投资和采购分别处理。
royal_steps.en: Identify sponsor, user, signatory and payer. Treat interest, investment and procurement separately.

royal_steps.zh: 分公司签约和持续服务
royal_steps.en: Contract and serve through the branch

royal_steps.zh: 按许可范围签约、交付、开票、收款与申报；定期向介绍人反馈进度和本地贡献。
royal_steps.en: Contract within scope, deliver, invoice, collect and file locally; report progress and local contribution to the introducer.

conduct.zh: 会议纪要、费用用途和授权保持清楚；招待及礼品按公司审批与当地规则办理，不向公职人员支付促成费，不以王室称谓替代法律和采购权限。
conduct.en: Keep minutes, expense purposes and authority clear. Apply company / local rules to hospitality and gifts; do not pay facilitation fees to public officials or substitute royal titles for legal / purchasing authority.

example.zh: 例如Emaar：由现有入口安排介绍；提出一个工程验收或供应商记录问题；请业务与技术团队评估；做有边界的诊断和试点；由实际采购主体与BUBIX本地机构签约。王室路径同样需要走到有职责的企业或机构。
example.en: For Emaar: use existing access for an introduction, propose a project-acceptance / supplier-record problem, involve process / technical owners, run bounded discovery / pilot and contract with the actual buyer through BUBIX locally. Royal routes likewise need an accountable company / institution.

compliance.zh: 按实际活动取得商业许可，律师出具产品边界说明。软件服务与虚拟资产经营不是同一项许可。
compliance.en: Obtain the relevant commercial activity licence and a counsel-reviewed perimeter note. Software services and virtual-asset operations are different scopes.

compliance.zh: 代币、托管、交易、金融产品
涉及受监管活动前，先确定主管机构及对应许可；迪拜VARA不覆盖DIFC，其他地区另查。
compliance.en: Before regulated activity, identify the regulator and approval. Dubai VARA excludes DIFC; other locations require their own assessment.

compliance.zh: 先确认数据权利、存储和跨境传输；上链记录不自动等于产权或政府认证。信任服务另判断许可。
compliance.en: Establish data rights, hosting and cross-border rules. Ledger records do not automatically establish title / government certification. Assess trust-service licensing separately.

compliance.zh: 企业税登记/申报不因暂无利润而省略。一般企业税率档按应税所得判断；VAT按应税供应及进口等规则判断，不能把两种375,000迪拉姆口径混用。
compliance.en: Corporate-tax registration / filing is not waived simply for lack of profit. Tax bands use taxable income; VAT uses taxable supplies / imports and related rules. Do not mix the two AED375,000 bases.

compliance.zh: 工作许可、居留、保险、工资和续期由分公司持续管理；常驻负责人组织，PRO及会计执行专业事项。
compliance.en: Maintain work permits, residence, insurance, wages and renewals locally; the resident lead coordinates PRO / accounting specialists.

compliance.zh: 阿联酋牌照不能替代沙特投资登记、商业登记、用工、税务和数据要求。进入持续经营与当地交付前单独配置。
compliance.en: A UAE licence does not replace Saudi investment / commercial registration, employment, tax and data requirements. Resource local operations separately before sustained delivery.

evidence.zh: 说明当地有实际经营载体；不意味着侯宇从零签署全部注册文件。
evidence.en: Shows local operating entities; does not attribute every incorporation signature to Andrew.

evidence.zh: 说明PRO合作有合同和日常服务记录；不是一句“认识政府”。
evidence.en: Shows contracted PRO work and service records, beyond a verbal claim of access.

evidence.zh: 说明税务申报事务真实存在；提交回执与已付税款分开。
evidence.en: Shows tax-filing operations; a submission is distinct from proof of payment.

evidence.zh: 当地用工与月度薪资资料
说明人员与当地管理事务有记录；不公开员工个人信息。
evidence.en: Shows documented local staffing and administration; private employee details remain confidential.

evidence.zh: 经营周报、法律框架与对接资料
evidence.en: Operating reviews, legal framework and engagement records

evidence.zh: 与履历共同说明经营协调、合同衔接和日常执行经验；不把草案当作已成交合同。
evidence.en: Together with the CV, supports operations, contract coordination and execution experience; drafts are not completed deals.

case_lesson.zh: 库迪验证的是“当地实体+常驻团队+PRO+法财税+经营管理”的组织方式。BUBIX可复用这套做法；区块链产品许可与技术交付，仍由相应专业团队负责。
case_lesson.en: Cotti demonstrates the local-entity, resident-team, PRO, legal / accounting and operating model. BUBIX can reuse that method; blockchain permissions and technical delivery remain with the relevant specialists.

decisions.zh: 确定当地设立与经营预算，优先推进迪拜主体及产品活动判断。
decisions.en: Approve local setup / operating resources and prioritize the Dubai entity / activity assessment.

decisions.zh: 明确常驻负责人、签约与费用权限；当地团队按阶段招聘。
decisions.en: Appoint the resident lead, signing / spending authority and staged local hiring.

decisions.zh: 安排律所、会计与PRO的首轮访谈；以服务范围、报价和责任清单选聘。
decisions.en: Interview legal, accounting and PRO providers; appoint by scope, quotation and responsibilities.
